# Half Bap Recording Studios

> Recording studio in Belfast city centre, Northern Ireland, open since 2011. Recording and production, mixing and mastering, voice overs, dry hire, sound design and remote recording, with producer/engineers Graham Davidson, George Sloan and Kacper Lewandoski.

## Key facts

- **Name:** Half Bap Recording Studios (often "Half Bap Studios")
- **Address:** 8 Commercial Court, Belfast BT1 2NB, Northern Ireland (Cathedral Quarter, beside the Duke of York pub)
- **Email:** info@halfbapstudios.com (replies within 1–2 business days)
- **Instagram:** https://www.instagram.com/halfbapstudios
- **Facebook:** https://www.facebook.com/HalfBapStudios
- **Opened:** 2011, by producers Graham Davidson and George Sloan
- **Rooms:** a 500 sq ft acoustically treated live room, a dead room / vocal booth and a control room
- **How to book:** email info@halfbapstudios.com or use the contact form on the website, saying what kind of session you need

## Services

- **Recording & Production:** solo takes to full-band live sessions across the live room, vocal booth and control room.
- **Mixing & Mastering:** for music recorded at Half Bap, at home or elsewhere; digital precision with high-end analogue outboard.
- **Voice Overs:** a fully treated vocal booth and a range of microphones for TV, film and theatre.
- **Dry Hire:** hire the studio and run your own sessions.
- **Sound Design:** soundscapes, foley and music for screen and stage.
- **Remote Recording:** the studio rig brought to your venue to record live.

## People

- **Graham Davidson**, producer/engineer: multi award-winning, 20 years in music; known for alternative rock, punk and indie.
- **George Sloan**, producer/engineer: working with artists since 2009 across bands, theatre and dance; work heard on RTÉ Radio 1, BBC Radio 2 and BBC Radio 6 Music.
- **Kacper Lewandoski**, producer/mix engineer: award-winning, specialising in heavy metal.

## Recent work

- Alana Henderson recorded "Not Going Anywhere" at Half Bap. The video premiered on The Thin Air in October 2026: https://thethinair.net/2026/10/video-premiere-alana-henderson-not-going-anywhere
